functions.name: chat_with_giulia
functions.title: Chat with Giulia
functions.description: Send a message to Giulia, the personal AI assistant for this app, and get her response. Use this to ask Giulia to plan the day, summarize, research, or handle a task — she has the app's context. Omit conversation_id to use the default conversation.

message.description: The message to send to Giulia.

functions.name: draft_whatsapp_reply
functions.title: Draft WhatsApp reply
functions.description: Have Giulia draft a short reply to an incoming WhatsApp message and store it for approval. Pass the incoming WhatsAppMessage id. Nothing is sent until the owner approves the draft.

message_id.description: The id of the incoming WhatsAppMessage record to draft a reply for.

functions.name: send_gmail
functions.title: Send Gmail
functions.description: Send an email from the connected Gmail account; the signed-in user is the sender. Provide recipient, subject, and body.

functions.name: sync_gmail
functions.title: Sync Gmail inbox
functions.description: Pull recent messages from the connected Gmail inbox into the app's Email records (deduped). Call this to refresh the inbox before reading emails.

functions.name: sync_calendar
functions.title: Sync Google Calendar
functions.description: Pull upcoming Google Calendar events (past week + next 30 days) into the app's Event records (deduped). Call this to refresh the agenda before querying events.

functions.name: sync_drive
functions.title: Sync Google Drive
functions.description: List recent files from the connected Google Drive into the app's Document records (deduped). Call this to refresh the documents view.
